I am an **Associate professor** (Maître de Conférences) in applied mathematics (speciality statistics) at Conservatoire National des Arts et Métiers ([CNAM Paris](https://www.cnam.fr/), [MSDMA team](https://cedric.cnam.fr/equipes/msdma/), [CEDRIC lab](https://cedric.cnam.fr))

**Research interests in brief** 

* nonparametric estimation
* survival analysis 
* functional data
* supervised and unsupervised classification
